answer: A hostile operator running 64 aliases therefore needs 98 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in voyage, expire in horizon, and yarrow lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 13 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4741 identities would post 2422 proofs and burn roughly 90 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
